# v0.6.1 — USDT / USDC checkout, multilingual docs and live demo

## English

Accept USDT and USDC across six networks and eleven supported combinations, including Base native USDC and explicitly labeled Bridged USDT. Customers choose a token and network, then pay through BoltUtil Hosted Checkout using a supported connected wallet or manual transfer. Route and wallet availability depend on merchant settings and the service.

### Changes

- Replace fixed daily quota wording with daily free allowance and subscription wording, linked to current service terms.
- Refresh README, merchant-facing promotion, real demo screenshots, English/Chinese banners and eleven translated introduction pages.
- Update all eleven bundled PO/MO translations and WordPress.org contributor metadata.
- Replace uncertain brand-kit distribution assets with documented CC0 BNB Chain/Polygon artwork and an original GPL Base illustration.
- Reject a malformed Webhook event ID without a PHP type error; expand exact-body signing, encryption, idempotency, payment-route and retry regression coverage.
- Preserve existing credentials, orders, USDT-only upgrade defaults and verified payment completion rules.

**Try the demo:** https://shop-test.boltutil.com/ — browsing is free; small purchases use real funds.

Install `boltutil-payments-for-woocommerce-0.6.1.zip` using WordPress Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin. `SHA256SUMS.txt` verifies the download. Source archives generated by GitHub are not the installable distribution.

Requirements: WordPress 7.0+, PHP 7.4+, WooCommerce 11.1+, HTTPS, USD store currency and a configured BoltUtil merchant account. Base confirmation depends on L1 finality; exact completion time is not guaranteed. Network fees are separate.

The plugin is available on GitHub and installed on the public demo store. It has been submitted to WordPress.org and is awaiting directory review.

## 简体中文

v0.6.1 支持六条链、十一种 USDT／USDC 网络组合，包括 Base 原生 USDC 和明确标注的桥接 USDT。顾客选币种、选网络后进入 BoltUtil 收银台，可使用受支持的钱包快捷支付，或手动转账。

本次更新包含：免费额度与订阅文案、真实演示截图、中英文横幅、十一种翻译介绍、运行翻译更新、图标许可整理、畸形回调事件 ID 处理及更多付款回归测试。原有订单、密钥和付款核验规则保持兼容。

演示店：https://shop-test.boltutil.com/ 。浏览免费，购买使用真实资金。下载 ZIP 后通过 WordPress 插件上传入口安装，使用 `SHA256SUMS.txt` 校验。插件已提交 WordPress.org，正在等待目录审核。
